title: Literary Institutions and State Funding, 2011–2019
goal: I can describe the Hungarian Academy of Arts and the Petőfi Literary Museum in the years 2011 to 2019 (*akadémia, köztestület, főigazgató*).
I can describe a person or a law by what happened to it, with a participle such as *kinevezett* or *elfogadott*.
I can state how the critics judged the distribution of support.
